decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The conversion of the single-family dwellinghouse to two self-contained one-bedroom flats, would represent a cramped overdevelopment of the site, which would be out of character with the area, would fail to provide a family sized unit, and would fail to provide any private amenity space. The proposal would therefore result in substandard living accommodation detrimental to the residential amenity of the occupants. Furthermore, the proposal would result in disturbance and a loss of privacy to the future occupiers of the flats, by reason of the use of the ground floor store and rear garden by the adjoining end-of-terrace property. The proposal is contrary to Unitary Development Plan policies (December 2003) ENV-B.1.1, H.3.4, and H.4.1.

Condition : 2 - The proposed parking arrangements, due to the restrictive size and shape of the curtilage and the resultant insufficient number of off-street parking spaces proposed, and would fail to provide the Council's parking standards, resulting in increased on-street parking pressure within the CPZ. The proposal would therefore result in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area, contrary to Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) policies T.1.4 and H.3.4.
description: Conversion of single-family dwellinghouse two self contained flats
